doc.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017

title: Leaving the Evans trio
summary: After almost seven years he left because of the road and low pay.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Did you resign from the trio?
Was there a reason for that?

Well again, I was tired of the road and I wanted to expand, trying to do some different things. You know I loved Bill, I loved the music, but I also financially it wasn’t the best. Okay? It was, I survived. It was okay. But I knew I had abilities and I wanted to be able to buy a house and plan for the future a little bit, and I knew I couldn’t do that if I’d stayed on the road with Bill Evans. And after almost seven years I thought —
